newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil sags.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil sags.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were softer on Wednesday alongside sagging futures markets, but prices were harder to ascertain after two fixed-price deals on Tuesday.
Two straight-run pieces were traded between refiners, both at $146 cif NWE.
An Russian M-100, sailing on the Pink Star, was also heard sold on Wednesday, but the price of the deal was not known. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
